method: Frozen independent output/exit expectations; JSON objects unordered, arrays/results ordered, decimal values exact, raw bytes exact. Preflight warms both tools. Supervised monotonic wall time includes process launch/capture. GNU time child peak RSS is null when zero/unavailable. Rotated tool order. Only equivalent cases timed. Coverage is the hand-selected observed sample, not all session query sites; components/probes/scale cases are separate. No general speed claim.

cases.note: Window reduced from five to two so the bounded fixture exercises a nonzero slice start.
Translate jq truthiness explicitly; presence alone would incorrectly keep a null screenshot.

candidate_invocation.query: .qualification.total_selected_http == 84 and length(.reports)==4 and all(.reports,.passed and .cleanup_passed and not .source_dirty)
.passed and .cleanup_passed and not .source_dirty and not .result.frontend_dirty and .api_binary_sha256==$api and .coordinator_optimize=="debug"

cases.note: Both tools use native null-input execution with identical bindings and no input files; the frozen query/output oracle is unchanged.
A constant suffix test translates to the existing compiled regex function.
Four-entry window reduced to two on the small fixture.
The inspected artifact lacked compiler_ir; jqz uses an explicit missing-field default.
Example window reduced from ten to two.
Project record counts after the observed tail slice to keep the oracle small.
Numeric/null/missing timing fields; the supplemental false-default probe checks the differing default contract.
Exact decimal comparison ignores spelling/trailing zeros; finite mean is exactly representable by both tools.
Unique scalar strings can be expressed through existing grouping and sorting stages.

Scalar grouping retains the outer report context. Explicit scalar sorting preserves the frozen ascending status order; group_by itself remains first-seen. This representative projection covers the grouped portion of the larger source summary.

The nonempty fixture has integral changed_moves, matching the inspected artifact schema. Scalar sum retains report context and exact i128 totals. Its empty identity differs from jq add, checked by empty-array-total-probe.
This ASCII sample has equal encoded byte/scalar counts. jqz explicitly measures UTF-8 bytes; unicode-json-byte-count-probe establishes the difference on non-ASCII input.

The immutable update filters the target array while preserving arbitrary other fields. Both tools sort object keys; jqz emits compact JSON. A separate component checks byte-exact compact normalized output.
Scalar unique returns distinct structural values in lexicographic JSON order, preserving the frozen ordered array of schema-key arrays.
Exact compact sorted output, including nested field order, is checked as bytes rather than order-insensitive JSON objects. Excluded from observed coverage.
Isolated stream component of the grouped report summary; explicit sorting matches jq group order. Excluded from observed-workflow coverage even though the scalar summary is now supported.
Isolated fault-selection component; jq truthiness is translated explicitly. Not a passing full-summary translation.

candidate_invocation.query: length(filter(.fixtures,exists(.actual_source_update?) and .actual_source_update != null and .actual_source_update != false and exists(.command?) and .command != null and .command != false and .command.code != 0))

cases.note: The two Unicode scalars occupy six UTF-8 bytes, plus two JSON quotes. jq length counts scalars; jqz byte_length explicitly counts bytes. This is not an equivalent translation.
jq ignores deletion of an absent object field; jqz path edits require existing targets and report missing paths explicitly.
jq // defaults over false; jqz ?? preserves false. This is a contract probe, not an equivalent translation.
Strict missing access is an error. The observed compiler-status translation supplies an explicit default.
Scalar grouping preserves the stream stage's first-seen order, differing from jq's key-sorted order. Array order is never canonicalized away.

Scalar sum uses the stream sum identity 0, while jq add returns null for an empty array. The observed total summary has a nonempty integral fixture; equivalence is not asserted over all possible inputs.
The installed jq's arithmetic rounds through binary floating point; jqz integer arithmetic remains exact.
jq keeps the last duplicate key; jqz rejects duplicate input keys.
An explicit zero-place mean rounds a halfway result to even; it is not an unrounded jq mean.
Both reject an unsupported type, with their documented evaluation-error exit codes.
Generated sanitized records match the inspected command-log cardinality, not its original payload bytes.
Synthetic 10000-HTTP/10000-fixture scaling scenario; excluded from observed-workflow coverage.
